scripts.dev:be: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n mock,fe -c yellow,magenta "cd frontend && pnpm mock" "pnpm dev:fe"
scripts.gen: cd backend && uv run python scripts/gen_contracts.py && cd ../frontend && pnpm gen:types
scripts.test: cd backend && uv run pytest -q && cd ../frontend && pnpm typecheck
scripts.setup: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && pnpm install
scripts.sample: cd backend && uv run python scripts/load_sample.py
